controls: identity, all v1, ordinary sliders, candidate-fitted affine and closest joint saturation/contrast grid (21x21, sampled every 8th pixel, RGB MSE)
decision_order: Any confirmed new severe artifact stops that candidate
At least 6 of 8 clearly visible changes in labelled overview plus detail review
At least 6 of 8 autonomous preferences over identity and best sensible control, ties are not wins
No release without separate skin/detail/common-resolution workflow validation
review: Autonomous labelled qualitative review, not human/population preference or globally fresh independent data. Quantized endpoints are diagnostics, not artifact counts.
failure: Do not tune on these eight reserved images. Retain result and decide next scope explicitly; no automatic promotion.
